preparedExecutionBinding.coreInvariant: The target generic MossProvider Adapter must consume the exact execution prepared by Backend/Protocol for the run and must not silently reconstruct a different transaction from Intent when the pipeline supplies one.

legacyPath.statement: On merged main, MossProvider.evaluate receives only runId/intent/decimals and the Moss/Kuru runner builds quote and unsigned action internally. This legacy ownership does not satisfy the target prepared-execution invariant.

targetPath.authority: Adapter-private Provider Owner integration input contract/proposal. It does not freeze the shared Evidence Contract.

requiredFields.runId: Run identity; binds the provider evaluation to the prepared run.
requiredFields.intent: Normalized intent (already accepted by the pipeline); must match the evaluated intent.
requiredFields.chainId: Chain identity; must equal 143 for the supported Moss path.
requiredFields.protocol: Protocol identity; must equal kuru for the supported Moss path.
requiredFields.quote: Exact ProtocolAdapter quote. Moss consumes it; Moss must not re-quote.
requiredFields.unsignedTransaction: Exact ProtocolAdapter unsignedTransaction ({ kind: "unsigned", payload }). Moss must evaluate this exact transaction.
requiredFields.blockContext: Backend Chain blockContext associated with preparation (INPUT context).
requiredFields.gasEstimate: Backend Chain gasEstimate ({ gasUnits }). Distinct from Moss simulator gas.
requiredFields.finality: Backend Chain finality status/context associated with preparation.

targetPath.coreInvariant: The Moss Adapter MUST evaluate the exact prepared unsigned transaction supplied by Backend/Protocol and MUST NOT silently re-quote or rebuild a different transaction from Intent.

exactTransactionFailClosed.rule: If the evaluated Moss transaction does not match the prepared unsignedTransaction in identity/material (from/to/data/value, or the applicable exact transaction representation), the Adapter must fail closed as invalid/failed and must not continue to Core/Decision.
exactTransactionFailClosed.failureClassNote: invalid is the preferred Backend control status; failed is acceptable if the Adapter cannot distinguish a mismatch. Never success and never a silent re-quote.

inputContext: Backend blockContext describes the chain context associated with preparation.
Quote provenance already present on the exact quote must be preserved where available.
outputProviderProvenance: Moss runtime identity (runtimeVersion / runtimeRevision / checkoutRevision / commit / packageVersions)
provenanceOwnership.orderingRule: The simulator-pinned block is Provider evaluation OUTPUT and therefore does not need to exist before Moss evaluation. It must not be required as an input.

targetPath.blockLayerWarning: These four block notions are distinct and must not be conflated or collapsed into one another.

mergedBackendPipeline57.alignment: The merged PR #57 field list matches the BE-033 MossPreparedExecutionInput V1 binding field-for-field (revalidated against merged main at 0e718667a4f76958228f4a46837bb57d670b1de3). BE-033 V1 is therefore aligned with the merged generic pipeline.

caveats.blockContext: A single generic block context cannot by itself express the four Moss block notions; that distinction is owned by the Adapter and the OUTPUT provenance block.
caveats.gasEstimate: Chain adapter estimate; distinct from Moss simulator gas units.
caveats.provenance: No explicit provenance field in the merged shape; Moss runtime identity remains Adapter configuration.

intent.minimumReceived.statement: Optional Generic/Kuru intent input supported by current code and contracts, populatable from the economic boundary. There is no non-null canonical real observation of a supplied value in the qualified success fixture, so a real runtime observation for a supplied value is UNQUALIFIED / not independently runtime-qualified. Absence from one real fixture is NOT MOCK_ONLY.

isReplay.statement: Moss normalization/internal field-level truthfulness signal. It is NOT retained as a generic per-field EvidenceField property: toEvidenceField(...) does not copy isReplay across the generic boundary. Generic replay truthfulness is carried by top-level provenance.mode = RECORDED_REPLAY via evidenceMode(...). No new generic field is introduced.

emptyActionVsNoRoute.statement: An explicit QUOTE/ACTION NO_ROUTE classification is a valid terminal outcome and is recognized before the incomplete-simulation/action fallback (executionStatus() tests the NO_ROUTE error before simulation coverage). An empty/missing action must not overwrite an already classified NO_ROUTE; only without NO_ROUTE does missing action material resolve conservatively to executionStatus=UNKNOWN.

unresolvedContractOwnerDecisions: Final shared generic PreparedExecution / Evidence type (the Provider Owner's required Moss Adapter input binding is specified as MossPreparedExecutionInput V1).
Freshness semantics and any stale threshold; whether the Moss path may ever classify real evidence as STALE (currently: no, and conservative behavior is UNKNOWN / fail closed).
Whether Moss UNAVAILABLE maps to Backend failed or unavailable.
Whether revertReason becomes a first-class generic field.
Generic gas semantics (chain estimate vs simulated units vs fee/cost).
Whether any of the above changes shared cross-Provider Evidence.

noNewLiveProbe.statement: No new live Moss probe was run for BE-033. Existing real success evidence is sufficient for every positive factual claim; #58 explicitly permits unavailable real evidence.
